Actor Jr NTR Thanks Fans After Shoulder Surgery

Actor Jr NTR underwent successful shoulder surgery at KIMS Hospitals in Hyderabad. Following the procedure, he was discharged and expressed gratitude to his fans for their support, stating it gives him strength. Doctors also released a statement regarding the surgery.
